notes: rc11 — terminals now SLEEP. FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON was set at startup and never cleared, so the panel ran lit 24/7 and the screensaver only painted a static image over a permanently-on screen — that is how an A920 got burn-in. Now: idle -> screensaver -> after 3 min the panel goes black (zero brightness + keep-screen-on released so the OS timeout can power it down). Terminals with NO idle image sleep too (previously they never slept at all). Wakes instantly on a job sent from a till (polling continues while dark) or on any touch.
